# Quinn Slobodian

## About the author

Quinn Slobodian is professor of international history at Boston University, and the author of several books including Globalists, Crack-Up Capitalism and Hayek’s Bastards. The last won the National Book Critics Circle award for Criticism. He has also been a Guggenheim Fellow.
